visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with wavy brown hair, wearing a green t-shirt and a brown apron with a '厌世' logo, stands behind a counter in a dessert shop. He smiles energetically, gesturing with his hands while holding a clipboard. The background features white shelves with small jars and a brightly lit, clean indoor space. (2) A male customer in a grey hoodie enters the frame. The shop owner points to a display of cookie gift boxes labeled 'WHY SO DELICIOUS' on the counter. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The owner holds up a clipboard titled '厭世甜點店內用規章' (Dessert Shop Indoor Rules) and points to the text while talking to the customer. (4) The scene cuts to an indoor living room where a man in a white shirt is lying on the floor using a large orange foam roller, then switches to him performing push-ups on a wooden floor. (5) Back in the shop, the owner and customer continue their dialogue. A sudden cut shows a girl in overalls holding a gold helmet and dancing wildly with a high-contrast inverted color filter applied to the footage. (6) The camera shows a couple in the background sitting on a single chair, embracing and swaying. The shop owner gestures towards them with a sarcastic expression. (7) The owner and customer face each other again. The owner rolls his eyes upwards until only the whites are visible. (8) The video concludes with a green graphic screen featuring the '厌世甜點店' logo, a LINE VOOM icon, and search prompts.

A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect occurs during a visual transition. (2) The conversation continues between two male voices. The primary speaker uses a comedic, slightly exaggerated tone with high pitch variability. Short percussive thuds are audible as objects are moved. (3) A new audio phase is triggered by a loud, distorted heavy metal music clip with fast drums and aggressive electric guitar, lasting approximately 2 seconds to match a dancing visual. This is immediately cut off by a 'record scratch' effect. (4) The audio transitions to a soft, sentimental piano melody with slow-tempo string accompaniment. The voices become quieter and more sarcastic. (5) The final phase features a return to the upbeat synth theme. A bright 'ding' sound effect highlights a comedic moment. The track ends with a short, branded musical jingle and a clear voice-over.
